# Crealize

> Crealize LLC is a Tokyo-based independent product studio. We carry products
> from 0 to 1 — validate, build, ship, polish. Brand: "Creative × Realize —
> transforming imagination into reality."

Contact: support@crealize.llc
Languages: English (/), 日本語 (/ja/), 繁體中文 (/zh/)
Products: 16

## Shipped products

- PurityLens — AI skincare-ingredient safety scanner: photo → OCR → analysis. (iOS)
- Fudeto — Daily one-stroke puzzle: one stroke, one graph, every morning. (iOS, Android)
- Kichitto — Receipt capture for solo founders: photo → AI OCR → auto-filed to Drive + Sheets. (iOS)
- QiFlux — The quiet, privacy-first cycle tracker. (iOS)
- moonpacket — Crypto red packets for Telegram communities — non-custodial, USDT / TON / SOL / ETH. (Web, Telegram)
- Tendo — Daily Hamiltonian-path puzzle: connect every dot in one unbroken path. (Android)
- Rythix 2048 — Music-driven 2048: numbers merge on the beat. (iOS, Android)
- Meishitto — Business-card scanner with on-device OCR — your contacts stay yours. (iOS, Android)
- XunNi — AI astrology and relationship readings across two charts. (Android, Web)
- Meguru — Cross-border commerce platform: listings, orders and settlement in one loop. (Web)
- YMY — Whole-enterprise design for a Japanese trading company: CI standard, logo vector masters, mascot system, environmental graphics and a four-language corporate site. (Brand, Web)
- dramaflow — AI short-drama production line with a ratified world constitution and shot-chain continuity. (Internal)

## In development

- iDokuta — Multilingual telehealth for foreigners in Japan (in development). (iOS, Android)
- Mairi — Trilingual personal health record (JA / 繁中 / EN): vitals, medication history and an AI symptom check that reads your own record. (iOS, Android)
- Kizuki — Social engagement OS: AI notices conversations across cultures, drafts the reply, a human sends it. (Web, Telegram)
- Todoke — Narrated short-video pipeline: script to captioned, multilingual video and publishing. (Internal)

## Method

Validate → Build → Ship → Polish.
Engineering principles: atomicity (one change, one meaning), explicit dependencies,
module boundaries, type-safe by default, zero-dependency bias, code as craft.

## Hiring

Remote-first, Tokyo HQ. Roles: Design, Engineering, Growth.
Contact support@crealize.llc — tell us what you shipped, not what you studied.
